# Seattle University

> Jesuit Catholic university in Seattle offering undergraduate, graduate, and professional programs with comprehensive admissions, financial aid, and student support services.

Seattle University, founded in 1891, is a leading Jesuit institution in the Pacific Northwest. The university serves prospective, current, and former students through integrated admissions pathways, robust financial aid programs, and extensive campus engagement opportunities.

## Key Topics

- Jesuit Catholic education
- Undergraduate admissions
- Graduate programs
- Financial aid and scholarships
- International students
- Transfer students
- Executive education
- Campus services
- Student experience
- Application process
- Redhawks athletics
- First Hill campus
- mySeattleU portal
- Redhawk Hub
- School of Law

## Admissions & Application

- [Apply](https://www.seattleu.edu/apply): Application portal for undergraduate, graduate, and law school programs.
- [Admissions & Aid](https://www.seattleu.edu/admissions-aid): Main admissions and financial aid hub for all student types.
- [Undergraduate Admissions](https://www.seattleu.edu/admissions-aid/undergraduate-admissions): Undergraduate admissions with campus tours and academic program information.
- [Graduate Admissions](https://www.seattleu.edu/admissions-aid/graduate-admissions): Graduate admissions for 50+ master's, doctoral, and certificate programs.
- [International Admissions](https://www.seattleu.edu/admissions-aid/international-admissions): International student admissions in Seattle tech hub with ranked programs.
- [Transfer Admissions](https://www.seattleu.edu/admissions-aid/undergraduate-admissions/transfer-admissions): Transfer student admissions with Transfer Link program and guarantees.
- [Executive & Professional Admissions](https://www.seattleu.edu/admissions-aid/executive-professional-admissions): Executive education including LEMBA, DNP, and nonprofit leadership programs.

## Financial Aid & Costs

- [Financial Aid & Scholarships](https://www.seattleu.edu/admissions-aid/financial-aid--scholarships): Financial aid, scholarships, FAFSA, and grants aligned with Jesuit values.
- [Tuition & Fees](https://www.seattleu.edu/admissions-aid/tuition-and-fees): Tuition, fees, and cost of attendance for undergraduate and graduate.

## Student Resources & Support

- [Current Students](https://www.seattleu.edu/current-students): Student portal with resources including Canvas, mySeattleU, and campus services.
- [Admitted Students](https://www.seattleu.edu/admitted-students): Next steps for admitted undergraduate, graduate, and transfer students.
- [Faculty & Staff](https://www.seattleu.edu/faculty-staff): Faculty and staff resources including Redhawk Hub, mySeattleU, and tools.
- [Parents & Families](https://www.seattleu.edu/parents-families): Parent and family engagement resources for student transition and support.
- [Veteran and Military Student Center](https://www.seattleu.edu/veteran-and-military-student-center): Support center for veteran and military-affiliated students with ROTC programs.

## Campus Life & Engagement

- [Alumni](https://www.seattleu.edu/alumni): Alumni Association connecting global community with engagement and benefits.
- [Events Calendar](https://events.seattleu.edu): Seattle University events calendar with daily updates and registration.
- [Visit & Tour](https://www.seattleu.edu/admissions-aid/visit-tour): Campus tour and visit planning for prospective students in Seattle.

## University Information & Support

- [Seattle University](https://www.seattleu.edu): Seattle University homepage: Jesuit Catholic university founded 1891 in Seattle.
- [News & Stories](https://www.seattleu.edu/newsroom): Central newsroom featuring university news and human interest stories.
- [Give](https://www.seattleu.edu/give): Donation page with scholarship support and recognition societies.
